up: Retrieve distinct ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), compound name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures) for all molecules that appear in the document identified by CHEMBL2417551. Only include molecules that have a non‑null canonical_smiles value. Order the result rows by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.chembl_id,
    md.pref_name AS compound_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2417551'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
